_comment: install.sh merges the two entries below into the hooks block of ~/.claude/settings.json, keeping anything already there, with __REPO__ replaced by this repo's absolute path and __VENV_PY__ by the venv interpreter (bin/python on macOS, Scripts/python.exe on Windows); install.sh --uninstall removes them. The recall hook fails open: any error exits silently and never blocks a prompt.
